newsitem.title: USA: Schnitzer talking to Hugo Neu on Proler.
newsitem.headline: Schnitzer talking to Hugo Neu on Proler.

text.p: Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc said on Friday it had begun talks with Hugo Neu Corp, which is seeking to block Schnitzer's merger agreement with Proler International Corp.

Hugo Neu, a co-owner of three joint ventures through which Proler conducts its scrap metal business, is conducting a due diligence investigation in order to decide whether to make its own offer for Proler.
Schnitzer said it had extended until November 1 its offer to buy all Proler shares at $7.50 cash each.
The extension also extends the period for withdrawal rights until November 1.
On September 15 Schnitzer and Proler signed a merger pact under which Schnitzer would pay $7.50 cash for each Proler share. Schnitzer's tender offer for Proler began September 20.
On September 26 Hugo Neu served Proler with a notice of arbitration alleging that the merger would breach three Hugo Neu-Proler joint venture agreements.
In the notice, Hugo Neu seeks to block the merger and recover unspecified damages allegedly in excess of $50 million.
On October 4 Schnitzer and Proler received a second request from the Department of Justice for more information on their proposed merger, in accordance with anti-trust law.
